tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (45)༄༅/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gdams pa phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i khrid kyi gnad 'gag gal che ba'i 'bru 'a
(45)༄༅/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gdams pa phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i khrid kyi gnad 'gag gal che ba'i 'bru 'a

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (45)༄༅// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i gdams pa phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa'i khrid kyi gnad 'gag gal che ba'i 'bru 'brel gsal byed nyin mo'i mgon po bzhugs so//

(46)༄༅// na mo gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī/ sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bstan pa rab 'byams mdo rgyud bstan bcos/ drang don/ ldem dgongs/ nges don rnams kyi snying por gyur pa/ phyag rgya chen po la ming dang bka' srol mi 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nang nas/ phyag rgya chen po yi ge bzhi pa la/ sngar du rtsa ba'i gzhung*/ de dag gi khrid kyi sdom tshig /de yi gsal byed du zin bris/ de'i rgyab chos rje yang dgon pas mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i zhal gdams shin tu zhib pa/ rje rgod tshang pas sa lam bgrod tshul gtso che ba'i rnal 'byor bzhi'i zhal gdams rnams khung btsun zhing byin rlabs che ba dang*/ de dag la ma 'thus shing ma tshang ba med pas/ so so skye bo'i yig 'jog mang po dgos pa chung zhing*/ rtsod pa'i dus 'dir tshad mar 'dzin pa'ang dka' mod/ 'on kyang skyes bu dam pas nan cher bskul ba la ngo mi bzlog phyir/ rang gi spyod yul gyi go tshod cung zad brjod par bya'o// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun skyabs kyi mchog /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rtsa ba gsum// kun 'dus (47)yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi// dgos 'byung rigs bdag rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dud// don brgyud snyan brgyud brda brgyud tshig gi brgyud// phyag khrid ji bzhin ma nor 'dir 'god bya// brtse bas rjes gnang byin gyis brlab tu gsol// phyag rgya chen po'i khrid kyi ston lugs rnam pa brgyad de/ zog po'i 'ur khrid ces pa don dang ma 'brel ba dang*/ 'dod po che'i dpung khrid ces pa tshig don gang yang rgyud dang ma 'dres pa'i lugs dang*/ shes chung gi dpe khrid ces pa rang la go ba nyams myong rtogs pa gang gi yang gding med par dpe thog nas khrid 'debs pa mu thug dang gsum ni skyon can spang bya/ paṇ+ḍi ta'i tshig khrid ces pa tshig ma lus pa blo la tshud cing don ma nor bar go nges shes pa dang*/

sgom chen gyi dmar khrid ces pa lus gnad sems gnad dmigs pa'i gnad bstan te/ rang sa'i myong ba rgyud la skye nges su sgom pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa'i myong khrid ces pa/ gang zag dbang po mtho dman 'bring gsum gyi rgyud la skye tshul dang*/ rang gis go myong rtogs gsum bstun te ma nges par khrid pa dang*/ rtogs ldan gyi (48)dgongs khrid ces pa slob ma'i rgyud tshod rig pas thod rgal gcig car du khrid gdab pa dang*/ rgan mo'i mdzub khrid ces pa nyams myong rtogs pa gsum rang gi rgyud la gang skyes pa de mdzub tshugs su sku gsum ye shes lngar ngo sprod pa'o// de lnga ni/ skyon med don ldan gyi khrid do// de dag dang ma 'brel ba'i bshad lo zhus lo// thob lo'i rnam g.yeng 'du 'dzin longs spyod dang bsres pa'i// sbom sbom sab sab don la ma bsnyegs pa la sku chen gyi sbom khrid ces bya ste/ lag len 'khrul pa'o// de ltar ma yin pa'i nges don dmar khrid 'debs pa ste/ de la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum las/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro brgyad ni/ gang zag sngon sbyangs las 'phro sad pa la nges bcas mi dgos te gsal 'debs pa tsam/ rje btsun chen po mi las nya ma dpal dar 'bum la khrid btab pa lta bu'o// dbang po yang rab sngon sbyongs dang*/ tshe 'dir yang sbyangs pa song zhing rgyud la/ skyes pa la don ngo sprad pas chog ste/ dpal ldan sgom po pa dang*/ rje phag mo grub pa'i rnam thar lta bu'o// de las gzhan pa rnams la go nges shing rgyud la rang sa'i myong ba ma skyes par khrid 'debs pa gal che/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro drug ni/ sngar bshad ma thag pa ltar skyes sbyangs kyis rigs sad pa la ma nges/ de las gzhan pa rnams la rang sa'i myong rtags ma thon bar bsgom dgos te/ de rnams kyis myong rtags gsung rabs spyi dang mthun/ rdo rje sems dpa' rang la thim rjes/

rang gang mos kyis lhar gsal btab ste/ tha mal gyi lus su nam yang mi gnas pa yin/ 'di zur du drangs na/ sngon 'gro bdun du 'gyur ro// dngos gzhi'i bla zhes pa ni/ mchog gi dngos grub 'dod pa'i gang zag la med thabs med pa'i bla ma'am srog ltar 'bral med ces pa dang*/ dngos grub dang yon tan kun gyi 'byung khungs yin pas nam/ mi bslu nges (49)pas dam pa/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gnas skabs mthar thug kun tu sgo gsum gus pas 'dud phyir phyag 'tshal lo// phyag rgya chen po'i phyag ni stong nyid blo bral/ rgya ni 'khor 'das thams cad de las ma 'das pa/ chen po ni de las mchog gyur gong na gzhan med pa'o// yi ge ni yig 'bru'am tshig 'bru yig sna bzhi'am/ lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu'i yig sna bzhi'o// don gnyis ni yid ches phyir brgyud pa ste/ brgyud tshul spyi dang bye brag so so'i rnam thar rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar ba'i rigs pas dpyad te bshad la nges shes bskyed/ brgyud pa de las byung ba'i gdams pa dngos la bzhi las/ gzhi yin lugs gdod ma'i sangs rgyas kyi rtsa brdar bcad pa la gsum las/ dang po nyams myong ltar bcad pa ni/ lus gnad sems gnad dmigs pa'i gnad gsum gyis slob ma'i rgyud la go myong rtogs gsum tshad du ma khel gyi bar du bla ma'i nyam myong gis slob ma'i rig pa dmar thag bcad/ khrid long yod rgyas pa la sems kyi bzhag thabs/ nam mkha' sprin chu lha skur ro// lhun po chu chad rang thag ltar// zhes pa dang*/ long med bsdus pa la de bzhag la// khyung chen rgya mtsho'i nyi zla dang*// bu chung rba rlabs bya rjes so// zhes pa gzhi rtsa bcad pa dang*// bzhag thabs bstan pa gnyis ka'i go chod/ des so so'i skal pa dang mthun pa'i ye shes rang thog tu khel tshe/ rig pa gcer mthong bzo gyad gar gyi brda thabs kyi phyag len bzhin yin lugs yin thog tu rgan mo'i mdzub btsugs su sku gsum ye shes lngar ngo sprod do// de nas gnyis pa 'grel pa ltar 'chad pa la sbrul gser rang bu choms por byung ba'i rtogs brjod kyi dpe don lung rig gis/

rim gyis thod rgal cig car ba rnams kyis ngo 'phrod tshul gyis/ gzhi lam 'bras bu spang gnyen rnams sgro (50)'dogs chod nges su rgyas par gtan la dbab pa'o// gsum pa gzhung lugs ltar 'chad pa ni/ sems nyid dang po gang nas byung zhes pa nas/ 'gyu ba rang grol du 'dug ces pa'i bar gyis/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi byed pa thams cad sems kyi rnam pa dang*/ de'i ngo bo skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar bstan/ des na sems nyid 'di zhes pa nas/ 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos te// zhes pa'i bar gyis sems rgyu rkyen dus snga phyi gang stongs 'phel 'grib/ phyogs ris rtags chad yod med skye 'gag 'khrul grol 'khor 'das spang gnyen dgag sgrub sogs mdor na/ tshig tu brjod pa yid dang blo yi bsam rtog thams cad de yin la/ de nyid de thams cad kyis ma gos pas snang dus na snang med/ brjod dus na brjod med/ bsam dus na bsam med/ blo yi dus na blo bral te/ ye gdod ma nas 'khrul pa ka nas dag pas 'khor ba zhes pa sems ma rtogs pa'i dri ma la kun rdzob tha snyad du btags pa tsam las/ nges pa'i don la 'khrul grol yod ma myong bas sems ye gzhi dang po'i sangs rgyas su ngo sprad pa'o// de yang sems cir yang 'char bas kun gzhi// de stong nyid chos skur ma rig pas 'khrul gzhi/ rig pas grol gzhi/ 'khrul grol gdod nas 'dus ma byas shing blo las 'das pas ye gzhi/ de'i phyir/ dpal brtag pa gnyis pa las// sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de nyid bsal na sangs rgyas nyid// ces dang*/ dgongs pa zang thal gyi rgyud las/ ho// snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad kun// gzhi gcig lam gnyis 'bras bu gnyis// rig dang ma rig cho 'phrul te// kun gyi gzhi ni 'dus ma byas// rang byung klong yangs brjod du med// (51)ces dang*/

'jam dpal mtshan brjod las/ sangs rgyas thog ma tha ma med// dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyu med pa// zhes dang*/ bde mchog ra li las/ sems can sems nyid 'od gsal ba// thog ma med pa'i sngon rol nas// dang po mchog gi sangs rgyas de// rgyu med rkyen gyis ma bslad pa'o// zhes dang*/ snyan brgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang las// gzhi nas ma bcos ye nas lhun grub la// tha mal rang lugs chen por bzhag pa na// 'pho 'gyur med pa nam mkha'i klong yangs su// skye 'chi med pa chos sku'i lus thob 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ste/ ye gzhi'i rtsa ba chod de/ nges par rtogs na/ dang po'i sangs rgyas yin go chod cing*/ mngon du gyur bas rig pa skad cig ma'i sangs rgyas/ de mnyam rjes med par brtan na rtogs pa mngon gyur gyis sangs rgyas/ de lus snang sems gsum gcig tu 'dres te sa lam tshe 'dir chod nas/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul sogs sgrub pa'i rtags mngon sum du ston par nus na/ grub pa thob pa'am tshe gcig lus gcig gis sangs rgyas zhes bya'o// gnyis pa bzhag thabs bstan pa sgom pa'i yi ge ni/ de ltar rtogs shing thag chod pa'i lta ba de nyid/ mnyam bzhag du lus g.yo med ri bo lta bu/ ngag smra med pi waṃ gsang thag chad pa lta bu/ sems rtog med dbug bral lta bur bzhag thabs drug gis chu bo'i rgyun ltar gong bzhin rjes thob gang snang ci shar thams cad de'i don las ma g.yos par bskyangs te/ rab mnyam rjes med pa/ 'bring rjes thob mtshan nyid pa/ tha ma rjes thob sgyu mar rtsol med du 'char ba ma byung bar du bsgom par bya'o// bzhi pa thob bya'i sgo nas 'bras bu yin yang*/ lta sgom gol sar shor na spyod pa rnam dag mi 'byung bas 'bras bu yang mi thob phyir/ man ngag gi chos tshan (52)gsum pa 'dir blangs pa yin pas/ don la bzhi pa 'bras bu'i yi ge ste/ rtogs pa'i ye shes de nyid bsgoms pas yengs med du bskyangs pas/

spyod pa chos nyid kyi lam du slong ba ste/ de la chos tshan lnga ste/ zhes pa ni ma rig pa nyid rang rig tu rtogs pas mun pa la mar me btegs tshe/ mun pa ma spang zhing snang bar 'gyur ba ltar ngan pa'i 'khor ba la dogs pa med/ bzang po'i myang 'das la reg pa med/ rmi lam rmi lam du shes pa ltar/ phyi'i snang ba la zhen pa med/ nam mkha'i dbyings su bltas pa ltar/ myong bya myong byed kyi mkhan po blo las 'das pas/ nang gi nyams myong la zhen pa med/ chu nang na gza' skar yod ma myong yang*/ rten 'brel tshogs pas chu dwangs pa'i ngos la ma 'dres gsal bar 'char ba ltar/ sems stong pa ji lta ba rtogs pa'i gsal mdangs/ rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ma 'dres so so ji snyed pa nyid du 'char bas/ mig can g.yang la mi mchong ba ltar/ las rgyu 'bras khyad du mi gsod pa'o// lta sgom dang 'bras bu la ltos pa'i gsum pa/ lta sgom gol gcod kyi rim pa la ltos pa'i bzhi pa la chos tshan drug gis/ dang pos yengs med du 'khrul phyir mi 'brang bar chos nyid ye shes kyi rgyas btab/ gnyis pas dbang po rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyi nyams len gyis 'dod yon lam du 'khyer/ gsum pas nyin mo'i 'khrul pa mnyam bzhag ye shes dang bsre/ bzhi pas rtogs pa'i 'od gsal ci zin byed/ lnga pas zhag re la rang gis rang la khrid tshar re gsal 'debs/ drug pas cha gcig lus gcig la 'bras bu ma thob na/ 'chi khar bar do dang por chos skur sangs rgya ba'i mtshams sbyor ba ste/ yi ge bzhi pa'i don mngon du 'gyur ba'o// gsum pa rjes ni yi ge bzhi pa'i don chu bo'i gzhung bzhin rgyun chad med par bskyangs pas/ gcig car rtogs grol dus cig tu (53)'byung zhing*/ thod rgal ba ni/ mtho dman shin tu che bas go rim rang la nges bstan cher mi yong la/ de'i phyir rnal 'byor bzhi'i rim pa nges bcas ni gtso bo rim skyes pa kho na la dgongs bzhin bstan/

sa lam bgrod tshul sogs ni spyi mthun du dgongs pa yin 'dug /gol sa gsum las rtogs pas bsdus pa'i bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum ni/ gol sa med cing sku gsum gyi rang bzhin yin la/ nyams kyis bsdus pa'i bde ba la zhen 'dzin byung na 'dod khams su gol/ gsal ba la 'dzin zhen zhugs na gzugs khams su gol/ mi rtog pa la blos byas su song na gzugs med khams su gol ba'o// shor sa bzhi'i ye shor ni/ dang por yin lugs ji bzhin ngo ma 'phrod pa yin la/ 'phral shor ni/ dang por yin lugs gtan la phebs kyang phyis su nyams len gyi gnad 'khrul ba'o// de la stong nyid shes bya'i gshis su shor ba ni/ 'khor 'das lam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong nyid skye med don dam 'dus ma byas yin pa de go /de ga 'gag med du shar ba'i byed las rten 'brel gyi mtshang ma rig par thams cad stong pa yin snyam rgyu 'bras khyad du gsod pa'o// stong nyid lam du shor ba ni/ sems ye stong chos sku rang ngo shes pa la brtan pa thob pa las 'bras bu logs na med pa'i don ma rig par/ da lta stong nyid bsgoms pas/ 'bras bu chos sku bzang po zhig logs nas thob par 'dod pa'o// stong nyid gnyen por shor ba ni/ spang bya 'khrul pa'i nyon mongs pa rang gi ngo bo ngo shes ma ye shes yin pa'i don ma rtogs par spang gnyen tha dad du 'dzin pa'o// stong nyid rgyas 'debs su shor ba'i blo chung rgyas 'debs ni/ gang snang ci shar gyi snang ba 'di kha stong pa kho rang gis rtsal dang mdangs yin zhing*/ 'di ga'i ngo bo stong nyid blo bral yin pa blor mi shong (54)bar stong pa yin snyam yid kyis rgyas 'debs pa'o// dred po rgyas 'debs ni/ dang po snang stong dbyer med ngo 'phrod pas/ snang bas stong go chos du stong nyid la snang ba dgag mi dgos pa'i nyams myong rgyud la skyes kyang*/ phyis sgom pa g.yel bas nyams myong drod de blos bcos te sgom dgos pa'o// rnal 'byor bzhi'i rtse gcig ni/

gnas pa gsum gyis rim pas/ yin lugs kyi ngang la mnyam par nam bzhag gnas pa ste/ res ma bsgoms kyang yong*/ res bsgoms kyang mi yong ba ni/ bzo gzob tu mi gtubs pa dang 'dra ste rtse gcig chung ngus bde gsal gyi ngo bo mthong*/ nam sgom sgom yong ba ni/ rtse gcig 'bring po ting nge 'dzin la rang dbang thob/ nyams myong de 'khor yug tu rgyun brtan zhing rtsol ba cher mi dgos par gnyid gyang phal cher nyams dang 'dres pas sgom med chen po yin snyam pa'i rlom pa byung ba ni/ rtse gcig chen po nyams kyi 'khor yug ma'o// 'di'i mnyam rjes gnas pa mnyam bzhag /mi gnas pa rjes thob a 'thas su 'char bas rjes thob btags pa ba yin/ nyams myong de yul med du rang ngo shes pa'i nges shes skyes na ngo bo mthong zhing zhi lhag zung 'jug ste rnal 'byor gyi ming thob/ nges shes ma skyes na zhi gnas rkyang pa dang gnas pa rkyang pa des lhag mthong dang rnal 'byor gyi ming thob/ zhen med kyi snying rje skyes na gzugs sku'i sa bon thebs pa ste rang sa'i 'gro don 'byung*/ gang shar nyams de'i ngang du 'gro na rnam rtog sgom du shar/ ting nge 'dzin de'i dwangs cha la rgyu 'bras rten 'brel la nges shes 'drod na kun rdzob la rang byan tshud/ mngon shes dang rdzu 'phrul phra mo dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi zhal mthong lung ston pa sogs lam gyi rtags shar na yon tan skyes/ de dag mi ldan na rtse gcig rgyud la skyes kyang yon tan rgyud la ma skyes rtsal ma rdzogs/ kun rdzob la rang byan ma tshud/ gzugs (55)sku'i sa bon ma thebs/ rnam rtog sgom du ma shar/ ngo bo ma mthong bas rtse gcig mun pa'i dkyil na 'byams zhes pa'i gol sa dang*/ gol sa de chod nas snga ma'i yon tan drug po brtan na/ rtse gcig chung ngus drod chung ngu dang*/ dran pa nyer bzhag bzhi/ yang dag spong ba bzhi/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ste tshogs lam bzhi gsum bcu gnyis so// rtse gcig 'bring po drod 'bring po/

sbyor lam drod dang rtse mo ste dbang po lnga dang ldan pa'o// rtse gcig chen pos drod chen po ste/ bzod pa chos mchog ste stobs lnga dang ldan pa'o// spros bral chung ngus sems skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral bar rtogs/ lam lnga las mthong lam ste sdug bsngal kun 'byung lam 'gog ste bden pa bzhi dang de ngo bo'am rdzas gcig la bzlog pa'am rnam pa byed las tha dad du dbye bas shes bzod ye shes skad cig ma bzhi ste skad cig bcu drug dang byang chub yan lag bdun te yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis so// spros bral 'bring pos sems rtsa ba dang bral bar rtogs/ chen pos phyi nang gis sgro 'dogs rbad kyis chod/ de la sems stong par rtogs kyang stong pa rgyu 'bras su 'char ba'i gnad ma rig na/ spros bral med pa'i skor rdzis khyer/ zhes pa'i gol sa dang*/ ngo bo ma mthong rtsal ma rdzogs pas kun rdzob la rang byan ma tshud/ chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje ma skyes na gzugs sku'i sa bon ma thebs/ sa rab dga' dri med 'od byed 'od 'phro ba sbyang dka' ba mngon du gyur pa ste/ drug pa man gyi yon tan med na yon tan ma skyes rtsal ma rdzogs pa'o// ro gcig chung ngus 'khor 'das gcig tu 'dres/ 'bring pos gzung 'dzin gyi rtsa ba chod/ chen pos chos kun mnyam nyid du rtogs pa'o// ro gcig shar yang chen por ma slebs na rtsal ma rdzogs dmigs med snying rje ma shar na gzugs (56)sku'i sa bon ma thebs/ du ma ro gcig ji lta ba rtogs kyang*/ ji snyed mkhyen pa'i rten 'brel ma shar na/ ro gcig 'dres pa'i rba la g.yengs shes pa'i gol sa dang*/ ngo bo ma mthong kun rdzob la rang byan ma tshud pa dang*/ ring du song ba mi g.yo ba legs pa'i blo gros rnams kyi mnyam rjes kyi rtags ma rdzogs na yon tan ma skyes pa'o// sgom med chung ngus bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral bar rtogs/

'bring pos lhun grub kyi rang sa zin/ chen pos 'od gsal ma bu gcig tu 'dres pa'o// sa dang po mthong lam rgyud la skyes pa nas/ sgom med 'bring nam sgom lam sa bcu ste chos kyi sprin dang*/ mnyam bzhag zag med kyi ye shes chen po gcig las rjes thob zag bcas 'phags lam yan lag brgyad yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis bcu 'gyur du rim pas 'byung la kun tu 'od pad+ma can rdo rje 'dzin pa bde ba chen po'i sa dang lam las mi slob pa'i lam ste/ de la rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis shes bya'i dri ma phra mo ma dag na sgom med nyi ma sprin gyis bkab ces pa'i gol sa dang*/ ngo bo ma mthong rtsal ma rdzogs/ sa bcu pa nas bcu bzhi bde ba chen po'i bar gyi spang rtogs kyi che ba mngon du ma gyur na gzugs sku'i sa bon ma thebs yon tan ma skyes la skyon de dag dang bral na mi slob lam ste/ yon tan thams cad rdzogs pas 'bras bu ma nor bar sangs rgyas kyis mngon du gyur pa'o// de la rtse gcig rgyud la skye dus chos brgyad tshe 'di'i snang ba zil gyis gnon nus pas seng ge rnam par 'gying ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ gnyen po'i bzung dran gsang spyod kyi dus spros bral rgyud la skyes nas snang ba thams cad bden med du 'char bas sgyu ma lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ yang dag shes dran rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'i dus ro gcig rgyud la skyes nas stong nyid snying rje zung du tshud pas nyan rang gi sa las 'das te/ (57)theg pa chen por yang dag par chud pas dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ ting nge 'dzin 'ong dran phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i spyod pa'i dus/ sgom med mngon du gyur tshe/ sa lam mthar phyin te rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ lhun grub mkhyen dran phyogs kun las rnam par rgyal te 'bras bu sku gsum mngon du gyur pa'i dus so// de la rjes thob mtshan nyid pa mnyam bzhag gi nus pas rjes snang ba sgom de'i shugs su 'char ba dang*/

rjes thob rgya yan pa tha mal du 'char ba'o// rjes shes so so'i mnyam bzhag de'i byin rlabs kyis shes pa sngar gyi tha mal pa dang mi 'dra ba dang*/ snang ba yang sngar dang cung mi 'dra bas rjes snang zhes bya/ rjes thob rjes shes/ rjes snang rnams sngar lugs su 'char na mnyam bzhag rtsal chung bas/ rjes byin gyis brlab ma nus pa ste/ tha mal blun skad la'ang*/ mnyam par e bzhag rjes la ltos/ shes pa lta bu'o// de la rtse gcig la rang sa'i mnyam rjes las mnyam rjes mtshan nyid pa med/ rjes thob a 'thas su 'char/ sa mtshams gnas mi gnas kyis 'byed/ dpe mis phyin shul khyi rjes byung dang 'dra/ spros bral mnyam rjes gnyis su 'byed/ rjes thob sgyu mar 'char/ sa mtshams dran ma dran gyis 'byed/ ro gcig mnyam rjes gcig tu 'dres/ rjes thob stod par 'char/ sa mtshams stong zhen dag ma dag gis 'byed/ sgom med rtog pa 'ba' zhig yin pas mnyam rjes med/ che 'bring chung gsum rtogs pa brtan mi brtan gyi gnas 'byed/ mnyam bzhag phung po lnga bral dang rjes thob tshogs brgyad 'dag tshul ni/ rtse gcig gi dus su gzugs kyi phung po dang bral/ sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa 'dag /spros bral dus su tshor ba 'du shes kyis phung po dang bral yid kyi rnam shes 'dag /(58)ro gcig gi dus su 'du byed kyi phung po dang bral nyon mongs pa can gyi yid 'dag /sgom med kyi dus su rnam shes kyi phung po bral kun gzhi'i rnam par shes pa 'dag /de la 'dag ces pa med par song ba ni min/ gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma 'dag pa'o// rtse gcig gi dus rgyu 'bras a 'thas su 'char/ spros bral dus sgyu ma/ ro gcig dus nam mkha' lta bu/ sgom med dus gzhi med rten cing 'brel 'byung du mkhyen pa'o// rtse gcig dus sems kyi ngo bo rtogs/ spros bral dus rang bzhin rtogs/ ro gcig dus mtshan nyid rtogs/ sgom med rtogs pa 'khor yug ma'o// de dag mdo rgyud bstan bcos man ngag tshad ma'i dgongs pa yin kyang*/

dwags po rin po ches gsal bar mdzad pas rtogs pa'i chos su byed/ rje dwags po sgom tshul gyis zhib tu zhus pa'i lan zhal gdams ma zhes grags/ dpal phag mo grub bzhi gsum bcu gnyis su dbye ba mdzad/ 'gro ba'i mgon po gtsang pa rgya ras kyis/ ngo bo mthong ma mthong*/ rnam rtog sgom du shar ma shar/ rtsal rdzogs ma rdzogs/ gzugs sku'i sa bon theb ma theb/ kun rdzob la rang byan tshud ma tshud/ yon tan skyes ma skyes drug gis phra zhib 'byed pa dang*/ lcags kyu 'ja' tshon bdag med pa ste rtse gcig dus kyi sgom gsum dang*/ phyogs re res 'jog ma de spros bral dus kyi sgom gnyis dang*/ 'khor yug ma ro gcig chen po'i dus shes bzhed/ rgyal ba 'bri gung pa spros bral chen pos drug ste/ nyan rang dang mngon rtogs mthun par bzhed/ ro gcig chung ngus sa bdun/ 'bring pos sa brgyad/ chen pos sa dgur bzhed/ sgom med che 'bring chung gsum gyi sa bcu pa dang bcu gcig pa ste gtso bor mdo dang dgongs pa bstun te 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi bzhed pa dang*/ bcu pa sgom lam du byas/ bcu gcig bcu gnyis bcu gsum bcu bzhi rnams (59)mi slob lam sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi sar gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa dang sgo bstun te skyes mchog 'ba' ra ba'i bzhed pa yin/ 'bras bu ni dam pa sku gnyis/ mchog gi dang po sku gsum dang*/ de las dbye bas sku bzhi/ sku lnga sku drug sogs rnam dbye mang du gsung mod/ de la sprul sku'i ye shes mkhyen pa gnyis ldan/ longs sku'i ye shes lnga ldan/ chos sku ye shes gsum ldan zer yang*/ sangs rgyas phyin sku gsum dbyer med ngo bo gcig pas drang don du dbye ba bstan pa tsam mo// de la yon tan stobs bcu mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ ma 'dres bco brgyad sogs chos sku gtso che ba'i yon tan dang*/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu/

gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu ste/ gzugs sku gtso che ba'i yon tan/ thun mong du kha sbyor gyi yon tan yan lag bdun/ byang chub kyi yon tan brgyad/ mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo rnam pa lnga/ mdor na sangs rgyas byang chub bcom ldan 'das te brjod kyis mi long zhing tshad bzung med pa'i yon tan rdzogs pa ste/ mchog gi dngos grub 'bras bu phyag rgya chen po dpal rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du gyur pa'o// spyan lnga mi ldan mngon shes drug ma thob// gnas lnga ma rig spang rtogs rtsal ma rdzogs// sgrub pa'i rtags med yid smon go yul mkhan// rgod tshang ras sogs sna tshogs ming ldan pa// mal pa'i rnal 'byor kho bo bdag 'dra yis// 'chad rtsod rtsom sogs mkhas pa'i bya ba la// 'jug pa'i 'os min nus pa ma mchis kyang*// sngon sbyang skye dran skyes sbyangs blo gros ldan// dam pa'i rigs nges tsā ri sku skye zhes// skyes bu mchog gis nan cher bskul ba'i ngor// rang gis go yul mdo tsam yi ger bkod// nor 'khrul mchis na mkhas grub rnams la (60)bshags// de las byung ba'i dge tshogs dpag med kyis// mkha' mnyam 'gro kun rdo rje 'chang thob shog /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan gyur cig /

slar yang*/ dpal kun tu bzang po'i nags khrod du zhib par brtags shing dpyad de sdeb skyon phra mo'ang bsal yod pas shin tu dag pa yod/ sus zer na kho bo drung yig ras pas dge sbyor skyong ma nus pa'i skabs su'o//
